title: Book a Service Appointment
job_text: 1. Use a service like Grok Bot to book a service appointment. Provide the location and desired time. 2. Choose a payment method like Stripe Link to handle payment. Do not share payment credentials. 3. Review the confirmation from the service and verify the appointment details. 4. Show the confirmation with the appointment details and payment information.
what_happened: Matt booked a haircut using a service and received a confirmation with appointment details and payment information.

evidence.note: Imported from the X thread tagged for @tryreallybot.
